$comment: DNA OS — MCP discovery for external contractors (NEW-2, 2026-09-23). Freebuff loads this file (and .agents/) from the working directory when run with --trust-agents; Cline is registered separately in its own cline_mcp_settings.json. This file only POINTS at the DNA OS MCP server — it holds no credential: DNA_OS_API_TOKEN must be exported by whoever launches Freebuff (a token value must never be committed here).

dna-os.description: DNA OS central coordinator. Contractors PULL work through contractor.task.claim, report back through contractor.evidence.submit, and read status through contractor.status. Read-only tools are safe to auto-run; claim/submit require the DNA OS API token and Owner approval per the Worker Contract.
